c.title: $4,500 / 4br - 1979ft2 - 4 Bedroom, Two Bathroom Home in West Point Grey (Vancouver)
c.description:
This charming home in the desirable West Point Grey neighbourhood is incredibly well located and features four bedrooms and two bathrooms split over two levels.

Centrally located on W12th Avenue, this home features nearby access to some incredible neighbourhood amenities. Access to 16th Avenue make access a breeze for anyone who works or studies at UBC, and only steps away from West Point Grey Park, Jericho Hill. W 10th Avenue provides walkable access to daily essentials, such as charming neighbourhood dining, retail, pharmacy, post office, dental, and more.

The entryway opens up to the large living room and dining room area with a large South facing window bringing in tons of natural light. The updated kitchen features a breakfast nook large enough to fit a table, allowing for a quick bite on busy mornings, or a nice brunch on a relaxed weekend. A large primary bedroom features two closets for great storage. Lower level features two bedrooms with a full bathroom, a full kitchen, and laundry.

This property is located within the catchment boundaries for Queen Mary Elementary, and Lord Byng Secondary School


Lease Terms:
- 12 month fixed term
- Tenants responsible for utilities
- Tenant insurance required
- Credit Check Required
- Unfurnished

RDG Properties Inc.
